info.title: UnityCtl.Cli
info.description: Command-line interface for remotely controlling Unity Editor. Send commands to Unity from your terminal or CI/CD pipeline.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: UnityCtl - CLI tool for controlling Unity Editor

options.name: --project
options.description: Path to Unity project root (optional, will auto-detect if not specified)

options.name: --agent-id
options.description: Agent ID for distinguishing multiple agents

options.name: --json
options.description: Output JSON responses instead of human-readable text

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for commands sent to Unity (overrides the per-command default)

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Set up unityctl for a Unity project (config + package + skill)

options.name: --method
options.description: Package installation method: upm (git URL) or local (file path)

options.name: --skip-package
options.description: Skip Unity package installation

options.name: --skip-skill
options.description: Skip Claude Code skill installation

options.name: --global-skill
options.description: Install skill globally (~/.claude/skills/) instead of locally

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip confirmation prompts (non-interactive mode)

commands.name: update
commands.description: Update UnityCtl CLI, bridge, and Unity package

options.name: --check
options.description: Check for updates without installing

options.name: --tools-only
options.description: Only update CLI and Bridge tools (skip Unity package and skill)

options.name: --package-only
options.description: Only update Unity package (skip CLI and Bridge tools)

options.name: --version
options.description: Specific version to update to (default: latest)

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip confirmation prompts

options.name: --skip-skill
options.description: Skip Claude Code skill update

options.name: --method
options.description: Installation method: upm (git URL) or local (file path)

options.name: --version
options.description: Package version tag (e.g., v0.3.1). Default: current CLI version

options.name: --local-path
options.description: Path to local UnityCtl.UnityPackage directory (for --method local)

commands.name: update
commands.description: Update Unity package to latest version

options.name: --version
options.description: Package version tag (e.g., v0.3.1). Default: current CLI version

options.name: --global
options.description: Add to global ~/.claude/skills/ instead of local .claude/skills/

options.name: --claude-dir
options.description: Custom Claude directory (default: ~/.claude or ./.claude)

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing skill file without prompting

commands.name: rebuild
commands.description: Rebuild composed SKILL.md from base + plugins + user extra

options.name: --global
options.description: Rebuild global ~/.claude/skills/ instead of local .claude/skills/

options.name: --claude-dir
options.description: Custom Claude directory (default: ~/.claude or ./.claude)

options.name: --global
options.description: Remove from global ~/.claude/skills/ instead of local .claude/skills/

options.name: --claude-dir
options.description: Custom Claude directory

options.name: --global
options.description: Create in user-level ~/.unityctl/plugins/ instead of project-level

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show project status including Unity Editor and bridge state

commands.name: wait
commands.description: Wait until Unity Editor is connected and ready to accept commands

options.name: --poll-timeout
options.description: Maximum seconds to wait for Unity to be ready (default: 120, or wait-timeout from config)

options.name: -f
options.description: Follow log output (stream continuously)

options.name: -n
options.description: Limit to N most recent lines (default: all since last clear)

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable colored output

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show all fields including timestamps

options.name: --full
options.description: Show full log history (ignore clear watermark)

options.name: --stack
options.description: Show stack traces for log entries

options.name: --level
options.description: Minimum log level: log, warning, error (default: all)

commands.name: run
commands.description: Launch Unity Editor for this project

options.name: --wait
options.description: Wait for Unity to exit (default: launch and exit immediately)

options.name: --unity-path
options.description: Override Unity executable path

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop the Unity Editor for this project

commands.name: dialog
commands.description: Detect and dismiss Unity Editor popup dialogs

commands.name: dismiss
commands.description: Dismiss a popup dialog by clicking a button

options.name: --button
options.description: Button text to click (case-insensitive). If not specified, clicks the first button.

options.name: --source
options.description: Source: buildSettings or all

options.name: --mode
options.description: Mode: single or additive

options.name: --additive
options.description: Load scene additively (shorthand for --mode additive)

commands.name: refresh
commands.description: Refresh assets and resolve Packages/manifest.json changes (like focusing the editor)

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all available Unity menu items

options.name: --mode
options.description: Test mode: editmode or playmode

options.name: --filter
options.description: Filter tests by name pattern

commands.name: capture
commands.description: Capture a screenshot of the game view

options.name: -o
options.description: Output path (same as positional argument)

options.name: --width
options.description: Override width (default: game view width)

options.name: --height
options.description: Override height (default: game view height)

commands.name: window
commands.description: Capture a screenshot of a specific editor window

options.name: -o
options.description: Output path (same as positional argument)

arguments.name: WINDOW
arguments.description: Window type name or title to capture

commands.name: record
commands.description: Video recording operations (requires Unity Recorder package)

commands.name: start
commands.description: Start recording video of the game view

options.name: --output
options.description: Output filename (without extension, defaults to timestamp-based name)

options.name: --duration
options.description: Recording duration in seconds (blocks until done). Omit for manual stop.

options.name: --frames
options.description: Number of frames to record (blocks until done). Alternative to --duration.

options.name: --width
options.description: Override width (default: game view width)

options.name: --height
options.description: Override height (default: game view height)

options.name: --fps
options.description: Frames per second (default: 30)

commands.name: execute
commands.description: Execute C# code in the Unity Editor

options.name: --file
options.description: Read C# code from a file

options.name: --class
options.description: Name of the class containing the method to execute

options.name: --method
options.description: Name of the static method to execute

arguments.name: SCRIPT_ARGS
arguments.description: Arguments to pass to the script's Main method (after --) [default: System.String[]]

commands.name: eval
commands.description: Evaluate a C# expression in the Unity Editor

options.name: --using
options.description: Additional using directives (e.g., UnityEngine.UI)

options.name: --id
options.description: Target object by instance ID (from snapshot). Injects 'target'. Comma-separated IDs inject 'targets[]' array.

arguments.name: EXPRESSION
arguments.description: C# expression or method body to evaluate [default: ]

arguments.name: SCRIPT_ARGS
arguments.description: Arguments to pass to Main (after --) [default: System.String[]]

commands.name: lookup-type
commands.description: Find loaded types by short name (returns FullName, namespace, assembly)

options.name: --limit
options.description: Maximum matches to return (1–100)

commands.name: members
commands.description: List public members of a type (properties, methods, fields, events)

options.name: --filter
options.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on member names

options.name: --static
options.description: Only static members

options.name: --limit
options.description: Maximum members to return (1–500)

commands.name: snapshot
commands.description: Snapshot the scene hierarchy as a compact, LLM-friendly tree with instance IDs

options.name: --id
options.description: Drill into a specific object by instance ID

options.name: --depth
options.description: Max hierarchy depth (default: 2)

options.name: --components
options.description: Include all serialized property values

options.name: --screen
options.description: Include screen-space bounds, visibility, and hittability

options.name: --filter
options.description: Filter by type:T, name:N*, or tag:T

options.name: --scene
options.description: Snapshot a specific scene (opens additively if not loaded)

options.name: --prefab
options.description: Snapshot a prefab asset

commands.name: query
commands.description: Hit-test at screen coordinates — what's at this pixel?

options.name: --context
options.description: Instance ID of scene object for in-context editing

options.name: --save
options.description: Save changes before closing

options.name: --discard
options.description: Discard changes before closing

commands.name: click
commands.description: Click a UI element by instance ID, name, or screen coordinates

options.name: --id
options.description: Instance ID of the UI element to click

options.name: --name
options.description: Find and click a GameObject by name (uses GameObject.Find)
